scope: 75-candidate finite-state dominance screen and default-ten-card multi-room acquisition research

dominance.improvement: no less block or damage to either target in all 12 states, strictly better somewhere; finite-state screening only, not universal dominance proof

campaign.policy: fixed visible-only heuristic from card effect definitions, hand, current resource, field and incoming enemy intent; no draw/discard contents, RNG, simulations of hidden draws, or reward forecasting; reward choice always first or skip
campaign.report: all deaths/truncations, HP, per-room turns, selected/drawn/played rewards, no hand injection; isolated uniform reward pool NOT production rarity/shop/event encounter integration

sourceAudit: per-card source verified flag, locator and naming status from saved records; no claim of fresh primary retrieval
